• Last‑minute souvenir shopping at Marché aux Puces de Saint‑Ouen. | • Lunch at *La Maison Rose* (iconic Montmartre spot). | • Flight back to JFK (≈ 8 h). | --- ### Budget Breakdown (per person) | Category | Cost (USD) | |----------|------------| | Flights (NY→CDG roundtrip) | $650 | | Hotel (6 nights, mid‑range) | $1,200 | | Airport transfers (taxi/uber) | $120 | | Attractions (skip‑the‑line tickets, tours) | $350 | | Dining (average $70/day) | $490 | | Local transport (Metro + occasional taxi) | $80 | | Miscellaneous (souvenirs, tips) | $150 | | **Total** | **$3,890** | *(Prices are approximate; book early for best rates.)* --- ### Packing Checklist | Item | Notes | |------|-------| | Comfortable walking shoes | Must for cobblestones. | | Light jacket & umbrella | Weather can be unpredictable. | | Reusable water bottle | Stay hydrated. | | Power adapter (Type C/F) | For charging devices. | | Travel insurance | Covers health & luggage. | | French phrasebook or app | Basic greetings help. | --- ### Tips & Hacks 1. **Book skip‑the‑line tickets** for major museums via official sites or reputable vendors. 2. **Reserve restaurants** at least 2–3 weeks ahead, especially for Michelin‑starred spots. 3. **Use the “Paris Pass”** if you plan to visit many paid attractions; it includes public transport. 4. **Take advantage of free museum days** (first Sunday of each month, or free entry after 18:00 on certain evenings). 5. **Stay central** to minimize transit time—Le Marais, Saint‑Germain, or near the Louvre are ideal. Enjoy your Paris adventure! Let me know if you'd like adjustments (budget, activities, or travel dates).
